name: dmon
reference: Tsitsulin, Palowitch, Perozzi, Müller. Graph Clustering with Graph Neural Networks. JMLR 2023.

upstream.note: The gcn.GCN and dmon.DMoN layers are imported unchanged; the patch is a single TF2 compat fix (add_variable -> add_weight). Training is run_dmon.py on the shared harness, not the authors' train.py.

architecture.doc: GCN hidden layers, one width per comma-separated entry. Paper uses 64 for large graphs and 512 for some datasets. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

collapse_regularization.doc: DMoN collapse regularisation weight; discourages the trivial single-cluster solution.
